claims.text: Road 2 Web Summit is in its eleventh edition and is run by Startup Portugal and Web Summit.
claims.quote: lançaram a 11.ª edição do Road 2 Web Summit (R2WS)

evidence_check.note: Executive Digest says it; Tek Noticias also says 'Esta e a 11.a edicao do programa promovido pela Startup Portugal e pela Web Summit'

claims.text: The programme selects up to 125 Portuguese startups for this year's summit.

evidence_check.note: both articles say up to 125

claims.text: Web Summit runs in Lisbon from 9 to 12 November 2026.
claims.quote: decorre em Lisboa entre 9 e 12 de novembro de 2026

evidence_check.note: says it

evidence_check.note: both say it

claims.text: The ALPHA and BETA packages include exhibition space and the chance to enter official competitions such as PITCH and the Startup Showcase.

evidence_check.note: says it

claims.text: Galp sponsors the programme again, with 15,000 euros for the Most Promising Startup and 5,000 euros for the Best Performing Startup.
